descriptionMarkdown:
This spaceship produces 10k legendary iron plates per minute from asteroids. The ship is designed to be as cheap as possible and uses the minimum possible number of quality buildings, so that entire fleets of these ships can be easily

How to use
1. Build a ship
2. Use a group of requests for a quick start and send about 4k cartridges for the fastest possible start
3. After literally a couple of minutes, the ship is ready for use and send it on a flight between the inner planets to collect resources, when the conveyor is filled with missiles, the ship is completely ready
4. That's it, in most cases nothing else is required of you, but there are a couple of additional settings
5. The constant combinator, which is located just below the main hub, is responsible for the amount of resources that will accumulate in the storages, you can change it at your discretion, also if you change this value, do not forget to change the interrupt in the main hub

Other useful information
1. The production of 10k legendary iron plates per minute is indicated taking into account the technology of crushing asteroids by 100%, so if you have it open more than 100% then the production will be higher
2. The ship's defense is created with a huge reserve, for adequate functioning you do not need weapons damage technologies at all, if you have upgraded defense at least to level 10, then you can remove the second row of missile turrets to make the ship cheaper
3. The ship has many protections against freezing, etc. Even if you suddenly make a mistake somewhere in its settings, you will receive a notification and over time the ship itself will unfreeze
title: Legendary asteroid collector. Legendary iron plates 10k per min. Asteroid upcycler
